Card Q&A.a: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 4 or further to the right on your side.
Card Q&A.q: What position on the memory gauge does "while you have 4 or less memory" refer to?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have 4 or less memory, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign], other than [Sea Animal], in any of its traits or the [TS] trait in the hand without paying the cost.
